bindings.title: Typed actions and capabilities
bindings.reason: HQ already declares the action id namespace (grammar.action); the KB type names that same family and must not be duplicated as an extension.

bindings.title: Authority grants and revocations
bindings.reason: Grant state is permission authority; HQ is read-only and must not expose a lookup that could be read as an approval.

bindings.title: Authority and precedence rules
bindings.reason: HQ records and compares authority rules; it never grants, so the rule type stays a namespaced catalog entry.

bindings.title: Capability and evidence status
bindings.reason: The HQ capability registry is HQ-owned; this KB status projection stays namespaced and never overwrites it.

bindings.title: Chrome profiles and account bindings
bindings.reason: Profile paths and account bindings are sensitive (S2); HQ catalogues the type but never stores cookies or profile data.

bindings.title: VIVIM commands and settings
bindings.reason: Commands are generated from source; the type is catalogued as vocabulary and is never an authoritative command list.

bindings.title: Commitments and follow-ups
bindings.reason: HQ holds no commitment or reminder store; the type is vocabulary only and schedules nothing.

bindings.title: Platform-wide configuration settings
bindings.reason: Config files remain the write authority and secrets stay out; a namespaced type avoids an HQ config store.

bindings.title: Platform contracts
bindings.reason: Contract files stay authoritative; the KB catalog type is discoverable vocabulary and not an HQ contract id.

bindings.title: Conversation summaries
bindings.reason: HQ ingests whole sessions, not KB summaries; a separate extension prevents conflating evidence with a projection.

bindings.title: Platform data models
bindings.reason: HQ declares grammar.model; the KB data-model type binds to it rather than creating a second model namespace.

bindings.title: Platform data schema registry
bindings.reason: The schema file stays authoritative; the KB catalog row is discoverable vocabulary, not an HQ schema registry entry.

bindings.title: Platform data types
bindings.reason: Type definitions stay in the model files; a namespaced catalog type avoids a competing type authority.

bindings.title: Decisions and rationale
bindings.reason: KB decisions arrive proposed; HQ decision register is owner-confirmed, so the types must not merge.

bindings.title: Device and performance intelligence
bindings.reason: Device facts are locally observed and coarse; HQ has no device table and the extension claims none.

bindings.title: Durable reference notes
bindings.reason: The KB entry points at an authoritative body HQ does not copy; a namespaced type avoids implying an HQ note table.

bindings.title: Devices, workspace and environment
bindings.reason: Machine and workspace facts are VIVIM-owned; HQ catalogues the type without claiming an environment table.

bindings.title: Failures and incidents
bindings.reason: Failure records are evidence with redaction rules; an HQ extension marks them as KB vocabulary, not HQ incidents.

bindings.title: Recurring questions and answers
bindings.reason: Recurring Q&A is a KB projection; HQ has no FAQ store and the extension claims none.

bindings.title: Features and acceptance state
bindings.reason: HQ declares grammar.feature; binding keeps one feature vocabulary instead of a parallel extension.

bindings.title: Platform and user flows
bindings.reason: HQ declares grammar.flow for model flows; the KB flow type binds to that canonical id family.

bindings.title: System health snapshots
bindings.reason: Health aggregates are runtime projections; HQ keeps the type namespaced and stores no snapshots.

bindings.title: Owner identity and locale
bindings.reason: Owner identity is S2 personal data with no HQ table; materialising a type would imply HQ projects identity, so it stays unbound.

bindings.title: Derived insights about the owner
bindings.reason: Derived personal inference; HQ runs no inference store, and a vocabulary row would imply conclusions HQ never drew.

bindings.title: Installed applications and last use
bindings.reason: Opt-in software inventory is VIVIM-owned; the type is catalogued as vocabulary only.

bindings.title: PC health and maintenance findings
bindings.reason: Findings are advisory and never executed; HQ records the type without gaining an action path.

bindings.title: Performance metrics
bindings.reason: HQ measures its own timings; KB metrics are a separate surface, so the type stays namespaced.

bindings.title: People and relationships
bindings.reason: Third-party personal data (S3), never phone-projected; HQ holds no people table and must not create one.

bindings.title: Policy and consent rules
bindings.reason: Policy text lives in documents and CANON; a namespaced type avoids a second policy authority.

bindings.title: Preferences and working style
bindings.reason: No HQ counterpart; the preference type is catalogued as namespaced vocabulary, not as an HQ store.

bindings.title: Projects, goals and status
bindings.reason: HQ registered spaces are not KB project records; the extension keeps the two concepts apart.

bindings.title: Provider accounts
bindings.reason: Email-keyed provider account identity is credentials-adjacent; HQ never stores account identity or sign-in state.

bindings.title: Models, features and limits per account
bindings.reason: Model availability is per account and plan-gated; HQ catalogues the type without asserting entitlement.

bindings.title: Provider and model quirks
bindings.reason: Observed provider behaviour is evidence, not an HQ contract; the type is vocabulary only.

bindings.title: Provider plans, costs and expiry
bindings.reason: Plan and billing facts are provider-observed display metadata; HQ holds no billing state.

bindings.title: Provider usage and quota state
bindings.reason: Usage is mostly unknown and provider-scoped; the extension records the type, never a quota fact.

bindings.title: Release notes and migrations
bindings.reason: HQ reads git history, not KB release notes; the extension keeps append-only KB notes distinct.

bindings.title: Operational runbooks
bindings.reason: HQ holds no runbook executor; the type stays namespaced so it cannot be mistaken for an operational capability.

bindings.title: Source catalog records
bindings.reason: HQ declares grammar.source; the KB source record names that canonical family.

bindings.title: Telemetry stream catalog
bindings.reason: The stream catalog describes VIVIM telemetry; HQ catalogs the type and duplicates no raw stream.

bindings.title: Use cases and user jobs
bindings.reason: HQ declares grammar.usecase; the KB use-case type is the same id family.

bindings.title: VIVIM Lock and mutability boundaries
bindings.reason: Lock classes are product integrity boundaries; HQ catalogues the type without claiming enforcement.

bindings.title: Vocabulary, names and aliases
bindings.reason: Lexical vocabulary (spellings, aliases, pronunciation) is not owner-confirmed CANON, so it stays a namespaced extension.

bindings.title: VIVIM workspaces and data roots
bindings.reason: A VIVIM workspace is keyed by root digest; an HQ project is a registered space, so the types stay separate.
